title: A soap film between two rings breaks
lede: A film stretched between two rings of radius R is a catenoid, the surface of least area. Slide the rings apart: past a critical separation no such surface exists.
notice: For small separations the film is \(r = a\cosh(z/a)\), with its neck radius a computed from the ring radius. Two values of a solve the equation; the larger is the stable one.
Around h/R = 1.06 the two flat discs already have less area than the catenoid. The film still stands for a while, but it is only a local minimum and can jump to the discs.
Beyond h/R = 1.3255 no catenoid fits between the rings. The film breaks and only two discs remain.
hint: Drag the slider; the colored marks show the thresholds. Drag the figure to rotate.
